rule.description: A class with at least 20 members (constructors, static blocks, and field initializers excluded) whose cohesion graph - members connected only when a method body references another member through this.<member> or <ClassName>.<member> - splits into at least 4 disconnected components, at least 2 of which contain class-level (static) state or behavior. Such a class centralizes multiple responsibilities that share no state and belong to separate owners.

checks.description: Detect a single class whose member set spans multiple disconnected responsibilities.
checks.detected_relation: absorbed responsibility -> static member on an unrelated stateful class
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Shared caches, cross-module helpers, and service validation logic pile onto one class as class-level members, so changes for unrelated reasons all route through that class (god class).

matches.evidence: SuspenseSubject exposes 34 members whose cohesion graph splits into 7 disconnected components: 2 instance-level components of per-observable subject behavior plus 5 class-level components absorbed from other modules (global preload registry, two service query caches, options field checks, auth claims validation).

The global preloaded-observable registry (Map mirrored onto globalThis._reactFirePreloadedObservables), its DEFAULT_TIMEOUT policy constant, and every library-wide preload entry point (generic observable, auth user, Firestore document) live as static members of the class; useObservable, the preloadFirestoreDoc export, and preloadUser forward into them while useFirestoreDoc consumes the class's doc-id helper.

Realtime Database query identity resolution (a cachedQueries array mirrored onto globalThis._reactFireDatabaseCachedQueries with .isEqual-based lookup, moved out of the database module) is a static helper on the class; the two database list hooks resolve their observable ids by calling into it.

Firestore query identity resolution (an array mirrored onto globalThis._reactFireFirestoreQueryCache with queryEqual-based lookup, moved out of the firestore module) is a static helper on the class; both firestore collection hooks resolve their observable ids by calling into it.

The shared ReactFireOptions field checks (structural key validation with its invalid-field error branch, initialData/startWithValue resolution, and idField extraction) moved from the package index onto the class as static helpers; the index re-exports all three as pass-through delegators.

The auth custom-claims validator factory (its closure builds hasRequiredClaims/errors results and constructs auth/missing-claim errors) moved from the auth module onto the class; useSigninCheck obtains its validator from there inside its token-result pipeline.

excluded.reason: A small single-responsibility error type (three fields, no methods with references); far below the member threshold and unrelated to responsibility centralization. Type declarations and interfaces are not classes and are outside the rule.
React component with app-context concerns only; no absorbed shared state or cross-module helpers, and it is not modified by this case.

These two instance-level cohesion components are the class's original subject behavior and are counted in the aggregate measurement only; they are not a separate responsibility match, because the credited overload is the absorbed class-level clusters.
